name: pinterest_catalogs-mcp
description: Pinterest Catalogs (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing. Every tool maps to a docum

platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_client_i.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_client_i.description: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_client_s.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_client_s.description: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_refresh_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_refresh_.description: Refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, catalogs:read and catalogs:write (apps have trial access until Pinterest grants standard access). Continuous refresh tokens rotate on every refresh: the runtime keeps the new one and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/pinterest_catalogs.json (0600).

platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_country.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_COUNTRY
platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_country.description: Two-letter country of the catalog items, e.g. US.

platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_language.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_LANGUAGE
platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_language.description: Language of the catalog items, e.g. en-US or EN.

platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_pinterest_catalogs_currency.description: ISO currency appended to prices ('24.99 USD'); required when update_listing sends a price.

tools.name: me
tools.description: user_account/get: {account_type, username, id, business_name} of the token user.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: items_batch/post with one RETAIL item {item_id, operation: UPDATE, attributes: {title, description, price: '<amount> <currency>'}} and no update_mask, so only the attributes sent are changed. `listing_id` is the catalog item id in your namespace. Asynchronous: status PROCESSING|COMPLETED|FAILED, raw.batch_id and per-item errors. Pinterest has no stock quantity (only availability), so `quantity` is not applied.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: items_batch/post DELETE removes the item from the catalog (and its product Pins); not reversible. Asynchronous batch.
